# signoz_dashboards (Data Source)

Lists all SigNoz dashboards (`GET /api/v1/dashboards`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "signoz_dashboards" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `dashboards` (Attributes List) Dashboards in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards))

<a id="nestedatt--dashboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboards`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `data` (String) Dashboard JSON document. Typically includes `title`, `description`, `tags`, `layout`, `widgets`, and `version` (often `v5` for current SigNoz layouts).
- `id` (String)
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is locked in the UI. Default: `false`.
- `source` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
